name: dsh-native-subagents
title: Decide whether DSH should run Trellis role work as native sub-agents
description: After the 0.7.0-beta.4 upgrade lands, decide whether this repository should configure dsh as a dogfood platform so implement/check/research run as trellis-agent-* sub-agents instead of inline. Beta ships the three role prompts and the trellis_wait dispatch protocol, but the fork keeps dsh in the inline group and the repo has no .dsh/ tree, so the imported instructions currently point at skills that do not exist. Requires measuring the impact on the dogfood byte-parity regression and on .template-hashes.json before choosing.
creator: codex

planningAttest.note: PRD rewritten with measured costs: adopt = 7 new .dsh files (43 shared files already byte-identical, 0 mismatched) + 7 manifest entries; keep-inline = 5 assertions across 4 test files, one of which is unsatisfiable in either direction. design.md records why adopt, why the manifest entries are mandatory (getConfiguredPlatforms reads the ledger; regression.test.ts:12249 fails on the half state), why direct write beats trellis init --dsh (init also hashes 23 .pyc and 5 .runtime files the ledger has never owned), and resolves R5 with the vendor docs: rank 100 vs 200, lower rank wins. implement.md gives 9 verifiable steps from repo root plus rollback.
